items.headline: Albany law firm offering Uber vouchers on Thanksgiving Eve
items.excerpt: The law firm Harding Mazzotti is offering free $20 Uber vouchers on Wednesday, November 25. The law firm said this is to help prevent drunk driving on the eve of Thanksgiving.

items.headline: New York institutes five-year ban on AI chatbot toys
items.excerpt: Gov. Kathy Hochul signed a bill on Tuesday instituting a five-year pause on the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of artificial intelligence chatbot toys in the state.

items.headline: Great Barrington man charged after Travelodge stabbing
items.excerpt: A Great Barrington man is facing charges after a stabbing on November 20 at the Travelodge hotel.

items.headline: VIDEO: Driver, police officer injured in Glenville car fire
items.excerpt: Glenville Police announced on Tuesday that an arrest was made following an investigation into a car crash last week.

items.headline: New outdoor space, stores open along Catskill Creek
items.excerpt: Foreland, an arts and culture campus in Catskill, has opened a new waterfront space and storefronts along the Catskill Creek. Foreland Waterfront opened to the public over the summer and runs about 500 feet on the creekside.

items.headline: Amtrak holiday travel up 6% for Thanksgiving
items.excerpt: Travelers across the Capital Region are making their way home for Thanksgiving to meet up with friends, family and share those last minute recipes-- and more this year are going by train.

items.headline: Colonie police investigator retires after 56 years of service
items.excerpt: A longtime police investigator is retiring following more than five decades of service with the Colonie Police Department.

items.headline: Historic site renamed Saratoga National Battlefield Park
items.excerpt: A national historic site in Saratoga County has a new name.

items.headline: Cohoes man pleads guilty to arson in Washington County
items.excerpt: A Cohoes man pleaded guilty to arson in the fourth degree in connection to a May incident in the town of Kingsbury.

items.headline: Scene One Entertainment files for bankruptcy
items.excerpt: In the Capital Region, Scene One Entertainment owns the Spectrum 8 Theatres in Albany, Movieland 6 in Schenectady, Wilton Mall Cinemas, the Greenville Drive-In and Huck Finn's Playland in Albany.
